## UNE 0074:2023 · highlighted standardisation result

```{=html}
<div class="media-row"><div class="media-image"><img src="assets/photos/une-biaxial.jpg" alt="Biaxial tension-compression test according to UNE 0074:2023"></div><div><span class="tag">Standardisation</span><h3>UNE 0074:2023</h3><p>The specification defines the shear test method based on biaxial tension–compression loading of cruciform specimens. CORA uses this pre-standard as a technical starting point for validation, comparison with established shear methods and further development toward complete standardisation.</p><p><a href="https://www.scipedia.com/public/Serna_Moreno_et_al_2024a">Read the paper describing the recommended methodology →</a></p><p><a href="https://www.une.org/encuentra-tu-norma/busca-tu-norma/norma?c=N0071374">Official UNE record →</a></p></div></div>
```
